017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages;
018
019import java.util.function.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.console.views.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.console.views.TableSpec.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.users.UsersRest.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.petstore.dto.*;
025
026/**
027 * The expandable row details of the console tables, shared by the page builders (which only need the declaration) and
028 * the resources that serve them (which pass a real lookup).
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * A bean-backed detail lists its fields explicitly, so the resource that serves it never depends on having been
032 * attached to a table.  Each field list equals the columns of the table it opens from, hidden ones included.
033 *
034 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
035 * <p class='bjava'>
036 *    <jc>// A page builder attaches the declaration; the resource serves it with a store lookup.</jc>
037 *    TableSpec.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"orders"</js>).detail(RowDetails.<jsm>order</jsm>());
038 * </p>
039 */
040public final class RowDetails {
041
042   private RowDetails() {}
043
044   private static <T> Function<String,T> none() {
045      return id -> null;
046   }
047
048   /** @return The Pets table detail, for building a page. */
049   public static RowDetail pet() {
050      return pet(none());
051   }
052
053   /**
054    * The Pets table detail: Details, this pet's orders and its history.
055    *
056    * @param lookup Finds a pet by row id, or returns <jk>null</jk>.
057    * @return A new detail.
058    */
059   public static RowDetail pet(Function<String,Pet> lookup) {
060      return RowDetail.fromBean(Pet.class, lookup).basePath("/console/pets").title("{name}").columns(3)
061         .section("Details", "id", "name", "species", "status", "price", "tags")
062         .label("price", "Price (USD)")
063         .tab(DetailTab.table("Orders", ordersView("pets-orders", "/console/pets/orders/rows")).id("orders").scopeParam("petId").countFromRows())
064         .tab(DetailTab.table("History", historyView()).id("history").scopeParam("petId").countFromRows());
065   }
066
067   /** @return The Sold table detail, for building a page. */
068   public static RowDetail soldPet() {
069      return soldPet(none());
070   }
071
072   /**
073    * The Sold table detail: the columns that table shows, and this pet's orders.
074    *
075    * @param lookup Finds a pet by row id, or returns <jk>null</jk>.
076    * @return A new detail.
077    */
078   public static RowDetail soldPet(Function<String,Pet> lookup) {
079      return RowDetail.fromBean(Pet.class, lookup).key("soldPet").basePath("/console/pets").title("{name}").columns(3)
080         .section("Details", "id", "name", "species", "price")
081         .label("price", "Price (USD)")
082         .tab(DetailTab.table("Orders", ordersView("sold-orders", "/console/pets/orders/rows")).id("orders").scopeParam("petId").countFromRows());
083   }
084
085   /** @return The Orders and Store tables' detail, for building a page. */
086   public static RowDetail order() {
087      return order(none());
088   }
089
090   /**
091    * The Orders and Store recent-orders detail: Details and the ordered pet.
092    *
093    * @param lookup Finds an order by row id, or returns <jk>null</jk>.
094    * @return A new detail.
095    */
096   public static RowDetail order(Function<String,Order> lookup) {
097      return RowDetail.fromBean(Order.class, lookup).basePath("/console/orders").title("Order {id}").columns(2)
098         .section("Details", "id", "petId", "shipDate", "status")
099         .label("petId", "Pet")
100         .tab(DetailTab.table("Pet", TableSpec.create("order-pet").rowType("Pet").dataMode(DataMode.CLIENT).dataUrl("/console/orders/pet/rows")
101            .columns(
102               Column.create("id").label("Id"),
103               Column.create("name").label("Name").href("/console/pets/{id}/summary"),
104               Column.create("species").label("Species"),
105               Column.create("status").label("Status"),
106               Column.create("price").label("Price (USD)").render(Render.of("decimal").meta("places", 2))))
107            .id("pet").scopeParam("orderId").countFromRows());
108   }
109
110   /** @return The Users table detail, for building a page. */
111   public static RowDetail user() {
112      return user(none());
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * The Users table detail: Details and the orders this user placed.  It serves {@code UserView}, so a password,
117    * email or phone never leaves the server.
118    *
119    * @param lookup Finds a user by row id (the username), or returns <jk>null</jk>.
120    * @return A new detail.
121    */
122   public static RowDetail user(Function<String,UserView> lookup) {
123      return RowDetail.fromBean(UserView.class, lookup).key("user").basePath("/console/users").title("{username}").columns(2)
124         .section("Details", "username", "firstName", "lastName", "userStatus")
125         .label("userStatus", "Status")
126         .tab(DetailTab.table("Orders", ordersView("user-orders", "/console/users/orders/rows")).id("orders").scopeParam("username").countFromRows());
127   }
128
129   /** @return The Pending changes table detail. */
130   public static RowDetail change() {
131      return RowDetail.inline().title("Change {id}").section("Details", "id", "summary", "author", "state", "message");
132   }
133
134   /** @return The Audit table detail. */
135   public static RowDetail audit() {
136      return RowDetail.inline().title("{action} {entity} {entityId}")
137         .section("Details", "id", "at", "actor", "action", "entity", "entityId", "detail");
138   }
139
140   /** @return The pet History table detail. */
141   public static RowDetail history() {
142      return RowDetail.inline().title("{action}").section("Details", "id", "at", "actor", "action", "detail");
143   }
144
145   private static TableSpec ordersView(String id, String dataUrl) {
146      return TableSpec.create(id).rowType("Order").dataMode(DataMode.CLIENT).dataUrl(dataUrl)
147         .columns(
148            Column.create("id").label("Order").href("/console/pets/{petId}/orders/{id}"),
149            Column.create("shipDate").label("Ship date").render("date"),
150            Column.create("status").label("Status").render(PillRenders.orderStatus()));
151   }
152
153   private static TableSpec historyView() {
154      return TableSpec.create("pets-history").rowType("AuditEntry").dataMode(DataMode.CLIENT).dataUrl("/console/pets/history/rows")
155         .columns(
156            Column.create("at").label("When").render("timestamp"),
157            Column.create("actor").label("Actor"),
158            Column.create("action").label("Action").render(PillRenders.auditAction()),
159            Column.create("detail").label("Detail"));
160   }
161}
